devon: Quick question — support partner wants ephemeral access to raw request bodies for debugging an embeddings mismatch. They asked for a temporary S3 link with examples. Can we provide hashed headers + truncated prompt snippets instead? Need a quick yes/no.

mel: what's in the headers? tokens or user ids?

devon: mainly X-Client-Id, X-User-UUID and Authorization bearer token. We won't share Authorization. partner needs context to repro. They asked for 10 example requests.

sophie: short answer: no raw auth, and Authorization must never leave. For X-User-UUID we prefer pseudonymization (HMAC) not reversible hashing. Also prompts can contain PII — limit to 160 chars and remove emails/phones.

mel: HMAC how? can we use our SALT env?

sophie: yes use internal HMAC key KEK_DEBUG with HMAC-SHA256 and store only first 12 hex chars. Example:
```
HMAC_HEX = HMAC_SHA256(KEK_DEBUG, X-User-UUID)
TRUNC = HMAC_HEX[:12]
```
Do not log raw UUID or email. Document the key rotation in ticket.

alex: from infra side, if we grant access it must be ephemeral (1 hour) and logged. Use temp role via bastion and put objects in s3://redwood-sec-debug/ with restricted ACL. Approvers: privacy + eng-sre.

privacy: +1 to HMAC + prompt truncation. Also require consent from customer (if end-user data could be PII) and an ACL showing which partner engineers will have access. No copies outside our S3. Retention: delete after 72 hours.

devon: ok filing ticket with details, tagging privacy & eng-sre. quick approval flow sounds good. I'll attach scrubbing script.

devon: scrub script (psuedo):
```
for req in examples:
  req['X-User-UUID'] = hmac_hex(req['X-User-UUID'])[:12]
  req['prompt'] = truncate_and_mask_pii(req['prompt'], 160)
  remove_field(req, 'Authorization')
```

sec-bot: audit-log created: ticket #8921 access-request by devon, approvers needed: privacy, eng-sre.

mel: small ask — please also replace emails with <redacted_email> and phone digits with <redacted_phone> in prompt masking.

sophie: agreed. also add a quick smoke test to ensure embeddings mismatch reproduced on scrubbed sample before sharing.

devon: noted. ticket #8921 created, attaching scrubbed samples and proposed s3 path. will await approvals. :thumbsup:
